labels_used: none (manual topic names; PRIMARY predictions; no gold or dev)

bases.unique_texts: in_model_pool complaint rows (quote these; say 'unique review texts')
bases.all_rows: all complaint rows incl. duplicates (Phase 7 trends)
bases.denominator: all complaint rows of the app on that basis, outliers included

methods.leave_one_out: app share / the topic's share of the other three apps' complaints combined
methods.pooled: app share / the topic's share of all apps' complaints (DANA is 64% of complaints, so pooled hides what is specific to DANA)

overrepresented.denominator: all complaint rows of the app, outliers included

fit_check_results.sample: 15 random complaint rows per app (seed 42), one row per distinct text, named topics only (outliers excluded); judged by hand from text and topic name
